## What's your idea? 💡
Tell us about the feature you're dreaming of!

## Why do you want this?
What problem would this solve, or what would it make better? (Totally optional, but helpful!)

## Any other details?
Screenshots, mockups, examples, or anything else that might help us understand your vision. No pressure though! 😊
